model: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500, random_state=42) with median imputation of zero-coded missing values; features: 8 medical measurements (excluding followup_score)
notes: Stratified 80/20 split (random_state=42). followup_score was excluded because it is a post-diagnosis follow-up measure that nearly separates the classes (AUC-like leak; test accuracy 0.927 with it vs 0.732 without). Zeros in glucose, blood_pressure, skin_thickness, insulin, bmi were treated as missing.
